project.title: Seasonal and Environmental Influences on Microbial Community Dynamics in the Dunk River Watershed, Prince Edward Island, Canada
project.description: Our study uses shotgun metagenomic DNA sequencing to investigate the microbial ecology of the Dunk River watershed in Prince Edward Island, Canada, a landscape shaped by intensive agriculture and groundwater-fed hydrology
